Name: Returning Player Experience Survey
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.40

Event Info:
In order to create a better gaming environment, the Command Central has decided to conduct a survey regarding the in-game experiences of returning players. Please tap the [Advance] button below to share your thoughts! Rewards will be granted upon completion of the survey.

Name: Return Support
ActivityDes: During the event, commandants in the "Return" state can complete the missions and get the rewards (the event ends when the Return state expires).

Name: Withering Crown
ActivityDes: Event Info: Play through the new story [Withering Crown] and complete missions.

Name: Simulated Battlefield
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Complete Normal Story 2-2 to unlock.
Mission Info:
1. Earn Simulation Scores upon clearing a stage.
2. Spend Simulation Scores to purchase items at the Simulation Shop.
3. The limited-time shop exchange ends on March 16, 2026, at 23:00 (UTC).
4. During the event period, clear Simulated Battlefield stages and consume a certain amount of serum to claim rewards.

Name: Signal Calibration
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.40.

Event Info:
1. Calibrate the signal to receive mysterious messages.
2. Claim the corresponding rewards after receiving the messages.

Name: Hyperlink Array
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. During the event, participate in online matchmaking or team up with friends to take on exclusive event bosses.
2. A team consists of 1-3 commandants. Strategically selecting characters and balancing class compositions will make challenges easier to complete.
3. This event features two bosses: [Radiant Dragon] and [Nocturne Stalker]. Each boss has multiple difficulty levels. Complete lower difficulties first to unlock higher ones.
4. Defeat bosses or sign in daily to obtain equipment. Enhance equipment to boost its power and make your characters stronger.
5. If the total equipment level of your deployed characters is below the stage requirement, you cannot join matchmaking or create rooms, but you may still invite friends to form a team and attempt the challenge.
6. Clear a difficulty for the first time or complete event missions to earn [Simulation Quantum], which can be used to redeem rewards in the [Quantum Exchange] shop.

Name: Crouching Cat, Hidden Rat
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.40.

Event Info:
1. Invite friends to form a team of 1-3 commandants (solo matchmaking is allowed).
2. Upon successful matchmaking, you'll be directly placed into a match with up to 9 commandants, randomly assigned to either the Cats or Rats faction.
3. Cats can use charged attacks to capture all Rats to win.
4. Rats can disguise themselves within the environment to avoid capture and win by surviving until the match ends.
5. Cheese will spawn at designated locations in the environment. Both Cats and Rats can collect cheese to activate powerful skills and gain match advantages.
6. Participate in topic competition and daily matches to earn Prestige EXP. Increase Prestige Level and earn rewards in the event!

Name: Desperado Clash
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. A new limited-time season of [Desperado Clash] mode is now available.
2. This season introduces a new Commission system. Complete commissions, rank up, and earn Mammon's Blessings to boost your battle power and resource earnings.
3. A limited-time shop is open during the event. Play any mode in [The Godfall Revelation] to earn Cardinal Crystals, which can be exchanged for rewards. The event ends on April 20, 2026, at 05:00 (UTC).
4. Use [R&D Tickets] obtained from the event shop to increase your rank in Desperado Clash and earn exclusive [Nameplates]!

Name: A Flash of Love
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. The event consists of 8 stages, each offering special cards for you to use.
2. Read your opponent's expressions or use your teammates' support to earn more points and win the game.
3. Complete stages to obtain character-exclusive story unlock items and use them to unlock new character stories.

Name: Frostheart Amalgamated
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. There are a total of 6 difficulty levels, all of which are highly challenging with [Zack the Frostheart Emperor] being the formidable enemy.
2. All members will be reset once knocked out during the challenge, making the challenge easier to complete.
3. Each stage has its own 3-star clearance conditions. Collectibles will be rewarded once a total of 3 stars is earned. The more stars, the higher the quality of the collectibles will be.
